movement_types: SELECT p.JEPRIJEM, p.DRUHPOHYBU, d.NAZOV, COUNT(*) AS N, SUM(CASE WHEN p.DATUM >= DATE '2025-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SINCE_2025, MAX(p.DATUM) AS LAST_DATE FROM SKPOH p LEFT JOIN SKDRUPOH d ON d.JEPRIJEM=p.JEPRIJEM AND d.CISLO=p.DRUHPOHYBU GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2
warehouses: SELECT s.CISLO, COUNT(p.IDPOH) AS MOVEMENTS, MAX(p.DATUM) AS LAST_DATE FROM SKLADY s LEFT JOIN SKPOH p ON p.CISLOSKL=s.CISLO GROUP BY s.CISLO ORDER BY s.CISLO
stock_balance: SELECT CISLOSKL, COUNT(*) AS CARD_ROWS, SUM(CASE WHEN POCETMJ<>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NONZERO, SUM(CASE WHEN POCETMJ<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NEGATIVE_ROWS, SUM(CASE WHEN POCREZMJ<>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS RESERVED_ROWS FROM SKKARSTA GROUP BY CISLOSKL ORDER BY CISLOSKL

links_EKASA_LOG: SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL, COUNT(ID_FV) AS ID_FV, COUNT(ID_SV) AS ID_SV, COUNT(ID_MO) AS ID_MO FROM EKASA_LOG
links_PENDE: SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL, COUNT(IDUHR_FV) AS IDUHR_FV, COUNT(IDUHR_FP) AS IDUHR_FP, COUNT(IDPOKDOK) AS IDPOKDOK, COUNT(IDBANOBRAT) AS IDBANOBRAT FROM PENDE
links_FAKVYUHR: SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL, COUNT(IDBANOBRAT) AS IDBANOBRAT, COUNT(IDZAPOCPOL) AS IDZAPOCPOL, COUNT(IDPOKDOK) AS IDPOKDOK FROM FAKVYUHR
links_MOARCHIV: SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL, COUNT(IDPOH) AS IDPOH, COUNT(STORNOID) AS STORNOID FROM MOARCHIV
card_identity: SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL, COUNT(DISTINCT CISLO) AS DISTINCT_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT IDR) AS DISTINCT_ID, SUM(CASE WHEN CISLO<>FLOOR(CISLO) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FRACTIONAL_NUMBERS FROM SKKAR
ean_duplicates: SELECT COUNT(*) AS DUPLICATE_CODES, SUM(N) AS AFFECTED_CARDS FROM (SELECT KOD, COUNT(*) AS N FROM SKKAR WHERE KOD IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(KOD)<>'' GROUP BY KOD HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
order_links_state: SELECT COUNT(*) AS LINES, SUM(CASE WHEN UZVYBMJ>0 AND UZVYBMJ<POCETMJ THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS PARTIALLY_FILLED, SUM(CASE WHEN POCREZMJ<>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS RESERVED_LINES FROM OBJPRPOL
attachment_bytes: SELECT COUNT(*) AS N, SUM(OCTET_LENGTH(DOCCONTENT)) AS BLOB_BYTES FROM DOCSTORE
vat_lines: SELECT SADZBADPH, COUNT(*) AS N FROM FAKVYPOL GROUP BY SADZBADPH ORDER BY SADZBADPH
recent_invoices: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM DATVYSTAVE) AS YR, COUNT(*) AS N, SUM(CELKEM) AS STORED_TOTAL FROM FAKVY WHERE DATVYSTAVE>=DATE '2024-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
